bullets.text: Within a supervised team capstone, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, used TF-IDF features and a logistic-regression classifier on labeled public policy excerpts; evaluated a fixed held-out split using macro F-score and example errors.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
In a supervised individual course project, implemented reusable Python modules for the recorded workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out document groups; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
